response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and capable Staff Software Engineer with strong backend and software craftsmanship skills, but he entirely lacks the executive leadership, organizational scaling, and strategic architectural experience required for a venture-backed CTO role. His background consists of individual contributor roles rather than managing managers, scaling teams, or owning high-stakes algorithmic financial systems at the executive level.
strengths: Extensive hands-on engineering background with deep expertise in backend systems and high-throughput microservices.
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD, and open-source platform development.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
concerns: Completely lacks executive-level engineering leadership and team-scaling experience (10 to 30+) required for a CTO role.
Missing deep architectural experience designing real-time, stateful AI systems for financial risk and working-capital management.
No demonstrated history of managing hybrid engineering models, outsourced teams, or executive stakeholder communication.
